title: Aide personnalisée au logement (APL): eligibility of home buyers (accession and location-accession)

source.entry_point: Aides_logement scope ÉligibilitéAidePersonnaliséeLogement, output éligibilité (Python: generated.Aides_logement.eligibilite_aide_personnalisee_logement, Catala 1.3.0)

attributes.name: mode_occupation
attributes.source: Logement.mode_occupation, constructors AccessionPropriétéLocalUsageExclusifHabitation and LocationAccession of ModeOccupation (aides_logement/prologue.catala_fr:143-149); read by L822-2 II (aides_logement/code_construction_legislatif.catala_fr:147-160), L831-1 1° and 6° (aides_logement/code_construction_legislatif.catala_fr:658-676, 754-763) and L831-2 (aides_logement/code_construction_legislatif.catala_fr:771-815)

attributes.name: type_pret
attributes.source: Prêt.type_prêt, enumeration TypePrêt (aides_logement/prologue.catala_fr:44-60); read by R832-5 and R832-7 (aides_logement/code_construction_reglementaire.catala_fr:3064-3074, 3102-3112)

attributes.name: date_signature_pret
attributes.source: Prêt.date_signature (aides_logement/prologue.catala_fr:55-60); compared with |2017-12-31| (>=), |2018-01-01| (>=) and |2020-01-01| (<) by L831-2 (aides_logement/code_construction_legislatif.catala_fr:771-815)

attributes.name: anciennete_logement
attributes.source: Propriétaire.ancienneté_logement, enumeration NeufOuAncien carrying AmélioréParOccupant (aides_logement/prologue.catala_fr:87-95); read by L831-2 (aides_logement/code_construction_legislatif.catala_fr:795-815)

attributes.name: date_courante
attributes.source: ÉligibilitéAidePersonnaliséeLogement.date_courante (aides_logement/prologue.catala_fr:378-381); compared with |2019-10-01| by aides_logement/arrete_2019-09-27.catala_fr:6070-6076. The domain starts at 2019-09-01: before that date every input raises NoValue (see FR-APL-1)

attributes.name: residence_principale
attributes.source: Logement.résidence_principale (aides_logement/prologue.catala_fr:164); read by L821-2 (aides_logement/code_construction_legislatif.catala_fr:42-46) and by L822-2 II for AccessionPropriétéLocalUsageExclusifHabitation (aides_logement/code_construction_legislatif.catala_fr:147-160)

exclusions.description: Every loan signature date of the label lies after every decision date of the label: the loan that finances the dwelling cannot have been signed after the date at which eligibility is assessed
exclusions.source: aides_logement/code_construction_legislatif.catala_fr:648-657 (L831-1 1°: dwellings "construits, acquis ou améliorés au moyen ... de prêts", i.e. financed by an existing loan)

logement.mode_occupation content (Propri.value: mensualité_principale 500 €, charges_mensuelles_prêt 0 €, date_entrée_logement |2010-01-01|, type_travaux_logement_d832_15 PasDeTravaux, type_travaux_logement_r842_5 PasDeTravaux, every boolean faux, prêt.accord_financement_représentant_État_outre_mer PasdAccord; type_prêt, titulaire_prêt, date_signature and ancienneté_logement from the attributes
logement.mode_occupation content (Propri.why: the fields that are not attributes are read only by the amount computation (or by the AL scope)

every other ménage and demandeur field.value: as in the official test Exemple1 (aides_logement/tests/tests_eligibilite_apl.catala_fr:16-107): date_courante |2020-03-10|, résidence Métropole, Mariés |2010-11-26|, three EnfantÀCharge (born 2001-01-01 Après with études, 2009-01-01 Pendant, 2012-01-01 Pendant; French, 0 € pay, no shared custody, a_déjà_ouvert_droit_aux_allocations_familiales vrai), prestations [AllocationSoutienEnfantHandicapé; ComplémentFamilial; AllocationsFamiliales], 1 other occupant, Locataire of a BailleurSocial conventionné (loyer 750 €, RLS 0 €, every other Location boolean faux, PasDeChangement), Zone1, résidence principale, décent, 80 m², propriétaire Autre, usufruit Autre, not let to third parties, no IFI, no unborn child, not R844-4; demandeur born 1970-05-02, Française, with every other boolean faux (résidence Métropole, demandeur Française)
every other ménage and demandeur field.why: same household as the other FR-APL tables

notes: Sub-table 5 of 5 of FR-APL (amount computation out of scope). In the encoding a LocationAccession can never be eligible: caractéristiques_prêt_l831_1_6 is declared (aides_logement/prologue.catala_fr:387) and used (aides_logement/code_construction_legislatif.catala_fr:754-763) but never defined, so it is always false; the R832-7 case of a location-accession whose seller holds the loan is encoded under caractéristiques_prêt_l831_1_1 and reached only with mode AccessionPropriété (CONVERSION.md). No official test of tests_eligibilite_apl.catala_fr concerns home buyers, so official_examples.csv has no data row.
